name: Aqua0 FX book keeper
description: Autonomous keeper for Aqua0 forex strategies on Arc Testnet. It buys oracle, book and vault signals with Circle Nanopayments, decides with a rules or model policy inside hard limits enforced in code, and rebalances tilted USDC/FX books from its own Circle wallet. It recommends docking when an oracle is stale; it cannot dock.
